title: Chief Executives, Senior Officials and Legislators
description: Determine and formulate the policies and strategic direction of organisations, governments, and other bodies, and direct and coordinate their resources.

title: Administrative and Commercial Managers
description: Plan, direct, and coordinate the policies and activities of organisations focused on business, financial, and administrative functions.

title: Production and Specialised Services Managers
description: Plan, direct, and coordinate production, operations, and specialised service delivery within manufacturing, agriculture, and related industries.

title: Hospitality, Retail and Other Services Managers
description: Plan, direct, and coordinate activities in hospitality, retail trade, and other consumer-facing service businesses.

title: Science and Engineering Professionals
description: Conduct research, develop and apply scientific knowledge, or design and evaluate engineering systems and infrastructure.

title: Health Professionals
description: Diagnose, treat, and prevent illness and injury, and promote public health through the application of specialist medical and clinical knowledge.

title: Teaching Professionals
description: Impart knowledge and competencies at various educational levels and develop curricula, instructional materials, and teaching methods.

title: Business and Administration Professionals
description: Provide specialist expertise in business strategy, finance, marketing, human resources, and organisational management.

title: Information and Communications Technology Professionals
description: Design, develop, test, maintain, and manage software systems, IT infrastructure, databases, and digital communication technologies.

title: Legal, Social and Cultural Professionals
description: Apply expertise in law, social sciences, and cultural disciplines to provide services in legal practice, social welfare, and cultural activities.

title: Science and Engineering Associate Professionals
description: Perform technical support and practical tasks related to science and engineering under the guidance of professionals.

title: Health Associate Professionals
description: Provide healthcare support and intermediate-level clinical services, working under the supervision of health professionals.

title: Business and Administration Associate Professionals
description: Perform technical and support tasks in finance, administration, sales, and business operations under professional supervision.

title: Legal, Social, Cultural and Related Associate Professionals
description: Assist legal, social work, and cultural professionals by performing technical support tasks in their respective fields.

title: Information and Communications Technology Technicians
description: Install, maintain, and support IT equipment, networks, and software systems, providing technical assistance to users.

title: General and Keyboard Clerks
description: Record, organise, store, and retrieve information, and perform routine clerical and administrative tasks in office environments.

title: Customer Services Clerks
description: Provide direct customer service and information, handle inquiries, and process requests at service counters and contact centres.

title: Numerical and Material Recording Clerks
description: Record, verify, and process numerical data and material transactions including financial records, inventory, and production data.

title: Other Clerical Support Workers
description: Perform clerical and administrative support tasks not classified elsewhere, including mailing, filing, and data entry activities.

title: Personal Service Workers
description: Provide personal services to clients including travel guidance, housekeeping, childcare, and other individual support services.

title: Sales Workers
description: Sell goods and services in shops, markets, and directly to customers, demonstrating products and processing transactions.

title: Personal Care Workers
description: Provide personal care and assistance to children, the elderly, and persons with disabilities in homes and care facilities.

title: Protective Services Workers
description: Protect persons and property, maintain public order, and respond to emergencies in security, police, and fire services.

title: Market-Oriented Skilled Agricultural Workers
description: Grow crops, raise livestock, and harvest natural products for sale in markets using skilled farming and husbandry techniques.

title: Market-Oriented Skilled Forestry, Fishery and Hunting Workers
description: Cultivate, harvest, and manage forest resources, aquatic life, and wildlife for commercial market purposes.

title: Building and Related Trades Workers, Excluding Electricians
description: Construct, maintain, and repair buildings and structures using materials such as wood, stone, brick, and concrete.

title: Metal, Machinery and Related Trades Workers
description: Shape, fabricate, and repair metal components and machinery using tools, welding equipment, and precision techniques.

title: Handicraft and Printing Workers
description: Produce handcrafted goods and printed materials using traditional craft techniques and printing machinery.

title: Electrical and Electronic Trades Workers
description: Install, maintain, and repair electrical wiring, electronic equipment, and related systems in buildings and machinery.

title: Food Processing, Woodworking, Garment and Other Craft and Related Trades Workers
description: Process food products, work with wood, sew garments, and produce other goods using craft and trade skills.

title: Stationary Plant and Machine Operators
description: Operate and monitor stationary industrial plant and machinery to process materials and produce goods in factories and plants.

title: Assemblers
description: Fit together and assemble parts and sub-components to create finished products in manufacturing and production settings.

title: Drivers and Mobile Plant Operators
description: Drive vehicles and operate mobile machinery to transport passengers, goods, and materials across road, rail, and other routes.

title: Cleaners and Helpers
description: Clean buildings, vehicles, and other premises, and perform unskilled support tasks in households, hotels, and public spaces.

title: Agricultural, Forestry and Fishery Labourers
description: Perform routine manual tasks in crop farming, animal husbandry, forestry, and fishing operations under direct supervision.

title: Labourers in Mining, Construction, Manufacturing and Transport
description: Carry out manual labouring tasks in mining, construction, manufacturing, and transport, performing physically demanding work.

title: Food Preparation Assistants
description: Assist in the preparation and serving of food in restaurants, cafeterias, hotels, and other food service establishments.

title: Street and Related Sales and Service Workers
description: Sell goods and provide services on streets, markets, and public spaces, including street vending and similar activities.

title: Refuse Workers and Other Elementary Workers
description: Collect refuse, perform messenger duties, and carry out other basic manual tasks not elsewhere classified.
